description: This file defines an Angular service named WebsocketService that manages WebSocket connections for streaming language model tokens, including connection handling, message processing, and event broadcasting.

classes.name: WebsocketService
classes.description: An Angular service that manages a persistent WebSocket connection, handles message events, and provides an observable stream of WsEvent objects related to WebSocket activity.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket connection is currently open.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a new WebSocket connection to the specified URL and sets up event handlers for open, message, close, and error events.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a string message through the WebSocket if it is open.
